$comment: PROVISIONAL stand-in profile for the F0-2 spike. Derived only from the Venta Borinc packaging photo (spikes/gemini-image/refs/venta-borinc.png). Not approved by the owner. Replace with values from real published posts / brand kit before production use.
name: Venta

sources.note: only high-confidence parts are used, see facts.json

green.from: green label band + Zn hexagon + BORINC wordmark (median #66b052 / #69b056 / #68a558)
green.use: accent fills, bands, rules, hexagon badge, large display text (>= 64px) only

green-deep.use: green text on light surfaces at any size, background for white text (contrast with white 4.6:1)

forest.from: green-deep darkened, not on the pack
forest.use: dark backgrounds for contrast posts and carousel covers

amber.use: boron badge and very small highlights only, never body text on white

stone.from: label body text (#777777), darkened slightly for contrast

display.why: Closest open font to the wide, heavy, slanted VENTA logotype when set at font-stretch 125%, weight 800-900, italic.

default.leading_note: Do not go below 0.96 in uppercase: Turkish İ dots and Ç/Ş cedillas collide with the neighbouring line (seen in the spike fixture at 0.9).

text.why: Geometric sans close to the packaging's BORINC and label typography; full Turkish coverage (ğ ş ı İ).

type.$comment: px at 1080 artboard width. Phone display scale is ~0.36, so 28px renders at ~10pt on a phone.

rule.$comment: short green rule under eyebrows, taken from the label (EC FERTILIZER / BORINC dividers)

logos.$comment: STAND-INS. Typeset placeholders rendered from the brand fonts, NOT the real logo artwork. Replace with official vector files.

product-venta-borinc.subject_box_format: [x, y, w, h] incl. soft shadow, measured
product-venta-borinc.note: Bag (with its soft shadow) occupies x 268-931, y 232-1019 of the 1200x1200 photo, so ~45% of the photo is white margin: crop with object-fit/object-position or size the larger than the visible bag. White background: place on white/very light surfaces, or use mix-blend-mode: multiply on light tints. Never on dark surfaces without a light panel. Do not upscale beyond 1200px.

motifs: green band with a raised centre tab (label top edge)
hexagon element badges: B on amber, Zn on green
short green rule (56x6) under eyebrow lines
generous white space, centred label-like hierarchy
